definition: A prompting framework that interleaves reasoning steps ('thoughts') with concrete actions (like tool calls), letting a model reason about what to do and then act, in an iterative loop.
details: ReAct (Reason + Act) combines chain-of-thought-style reasoning with tool use, allowing models to gather new information via actions and incorporate it into subsequent reasoning steps, a pattern widely adopted in agentic LLM systems.

citation.title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
